room.name: Inside the Elbow
room.hint: Strike a brass hub to turn its arm clockwise. A blocked destination cannot turn.
room.question: The upper arm opens the sunlight, but the lower arm is your only way back to it. What must each be when you return?

bank.author: Codex
bank.solution: Turn A from left to up, climb it, and settle on its top before jumping/dashing over B’s thorn guard to the hub-side landing. Hop and strike B downward to turn it left; B now supplies the high bridge and clears A’s right-hand destination. Jump back over the guard, leave B’s western lip, and return to the service perch. Turn A right to shine sunlight through the deep western duct, then cycle down, left and up to restore the shielded climbing wall. Revisit B: it now forms a roof over A, requiring a kick around its western lip and a dash back onto its top. Jump over the guard to the hub landing, then jump/dash to the east gate.
bank.nearestExisting: Precision p182 lights a tally and restores a safe beam path. Here the beam blockers are the actual access wall and departure bridge: A cannot turn right while B hangs down, and B becomes a roof over the return climb. The player must change both the machine order and their approach side.
bank.designNotes: The beam is not a reaction timer: the knight chooses when the room changes. No hint supplies the order.

review.feedback: All hinges can be skipped; retain the intended puzzle but make its physical order necessary.
changes: Rebuilt the western tally as a deep, eight-pixel beam duct with three-tile masonry above it, beyond touch and blade reach.
Moved the safe start two tiles east to preserve access to the first arm.
Added a visible thorn guard along B’s low approach and a small hub-side landing; A must become the high launch wall before B can be reached.
The guard is crossed from above on both visits, while B’s left pose still changes the return ascent into a roof.

bypassBefore.description: Strike the former shallow tally niche from the start, then climb unchanged B and exit without rotating any arm.

bypassAfter.description: The original direct receiver strike no longer reaches; its later low dash into unchanged B hits the visible guard.

wrongOrder.description: Try turning A right before preparing B.

bank.humanReview: User approved banking; numeric Fun /10, Difficulty /5 and Suitability /5 ratings remain pending.
